question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The incorrect spelling is: **Disapoint**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Disapoint"** is incorrectly spelled. The correct spelling of the word is **"Disappoint"**.
 
• The meaning of **"Disappoint"** is to fail to fulfill someone's hopes or expectations. (निराश करना)
 
 
• **Example:** I didn’t mean to disappoint you, but I couldn’t complete the task on time.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Consensus** (सहमति): General agreement among a group of people.

 
 
• **Example:** The team reached a consensus on the project timeline after a lengthy discussion.
 
 
 
• **Conceive** (कल्पना करना): To form or devise a plan or idea in the mind.
 
 
• **Example:** He could not conceive of a world without books.
 
 
 
• **Disappear** (गायब होना): To cease to be visible or to vanish.
 
 
• **Example:** The magician made the rabbit disappear in front of the audience.
